blocks.text: This chapter's locked contextual evidence includes 2 source-addressable item(s). The strongest eligible contextual observation is: The divisions 1-12, 13-27, 28-35, 36-39, 40-55, and 56-66 provide a practical reading map, not a proof of six authors or one uncontested macrostructure.

Locked CKL evidence: The Great Isaiah Scroll is an almost complete sixty-six-chapter witness broadly aligned with the Masoretic tradition but containing thousands of orthographic and substantive differences; other Qumran Isaiah manuscripts and pesharim show active transmission and interpretation.
